english_sub: THE ARCHER WHO FOUGHT THE BRITISH

topic.title: Thalakkal Chandu, the Kurichiya archer
topic.angle: Owner's topic bank: Kurichiya commander of Pazhassi; Panamaram fort 1802; executed 1805
key_facts: Thalakkal Chandu was a Kurichiya archer and a commander in Pazhassi Raja's forces
In 1802 he led the attack that captured the British post at Panamaram
He was captured by the British and executed in 1805
A memorial to him stands at Panamaram, Wayanad
